title: Customer Support Ticket Dataset
description: A compact dataset for testing ticket classification and response prompts.

tickets.subject: Charged twice for monthly subscription
tickets.message: I was billed twice for the same monthly plan on May 18. Please refund the duplicate charge.
tickets.expected_action: Verify duplicate payment and issue refund if confirmed.

tickets.subject: Cannot export report as CSV
tickets.message: The export button spins forever when I try to download my analytics report.
tickets.expected_action: Collect browser details and provide workaround while escalating bug.

tickets.subject: Change account email address
tickets.message: I need to update the email address on my account before my old email is deactivated.
tickets.expected_action: Explain identity verification and email change steps.

tickets.subject: Package marked delivered but not received
tickets.message: Tracking says my package was delivered yesterday, but it is not at my door or mailbox.
tickets.expected_action: Suggest checking nearby locations and open carrier investigation.

tickets.subject: Cancel annual renewal
tickets.message: Please cancel my upcoming annual renewal. I do not want to be charged next month.
tickets.expected_action: Confirm renewal date and cancellation policy.
